posts.title: Additions
posts.author: Xaydan
posts.body:
- Add additional families with their own passwords 
- Make it more aesthetically pleasing 
- Lock people so they can’t be accidentally deleted 
- add a place of birth section
- fix the children of divorce, for example when i made a child parents divorced and added a new spouse, it would glitch and make the child go completely off screen to the right
- make divorced spouses smaller

Memory Capsules

Each person can have:

* Voice recordings
* Favorite songs
* Videos
* Recipes
* Handwriting samples
* Personality traits
* Quotes
*Hobbies

Add events
Basically events with a date, such that it can later be added to a global timeline that shows events in order
